description: Aerial drone view of an urban road lined with buildings and trees; car and motorcycle traffic moves along the road, with pedestrians nearby.
The drone looks down at traffic; cars, including a car, and motorcycles, including a motorcycle, move between buildings; pedestrians are visible near the roadside.
Car and motorcycle traffic continues along a narrow urban street beneath the drone; buildings and trees line the road.
Aerial view of traffic with car and motorcycle vehicles on the road and pedestrians near the buildings.
The drone continues over the street; several cars are visible, along with motorcycle traffic, among dense buildings.
The view widens over the area, showing car and motorcycle traffic on the road, with buildings and trees.
A wider aerial view shows a busy urban street with car and motorcycle traffic moving through the neighborhood.
The drone rises to a broad view of buildings and roads; some car traffic is visible in the distance.
The clip ends on a hazy skyline at sunset; the road traffic is no longer clearly visible.
